description: tiers is an array of [minTotal, percentOff] sorted by minTotal ascending. Return cartTotal multiplied by (1 - p/100) using the highest tier whose minTotal is <= cartTotal. If no tier applies, return cartTotal unchanged. Empty tiers returns cartTotal.
descriptionStarved: Apply a tiered percentage discount to a cart total.

description: schema is an object mapping key -> { type: 'string'|'number'|'boolean', required?: boolean }. Return an array of error message strings (empty if valid). Errors include: missing required keys, wrong type. Unknown extra keys in config are allowed and produce no error.
descriptionStarved: Validate a config object against a schema. Return an array of error messages.

description: event is { level, msg, fields? } where fields is an object. ctx is { service, host }. Return a string of the form: [LEVEL] service@host: msg | k1=v1 k2=v2. LEVEL is event.level upper-cased. If fields is missing or empty, omit the ' | k=v' suffix entirely (no trailing space, no trailing pipe). Fields are emitted in insertion order.
descriptionStarved: Format a log event with context as a single-line string.

description: rules is an array of { role, perms } objects where perms is an array of strings. Return a Map from role name to a Set of perm strings. If multiple rules have the same role, union their perms.
descriptionStarved: Merge ACL rules from many sources into a single per-role permission collection.

description: Split arr into consecutive sub-arrays of length size. The last chunk may be shorter if arr length is not divisible by size. If size <= 0 or arr is empty, return [].
descriptionStarved: Split an array into batches of a given size.

description: Return a URL-safe slug: lowercase, replace runs of non-alphanumeric ASCII with a single hyphen, trim leading and trailing hyphens. Non-ASCII characters are treated as non-alphanumeric (so they become hyphens or get collapsed).
descriptionStarved: Produce a URL-safe slug from a title string.

description: keyFn maps an item to a key. Return an object mapping each key (string form) to an array of items in their original order. Empty items returns {}.
descriptionStarved: Group items by a key function.

description: qs is a query string optionally starting with '?'. Return an object mapping decoded keys to decoded values. Duplicate keys collapse last-write-wins. Keys with no '=' map to an empty string. Empty qs returns {}.
descriptionStarved: Parse a URL query string into an object.

description: Return [truthy, falsy] where truthy is the items of arr for which pred(item) returns truthy, and falsy is the rest. Preserve order in both.
descriptionStarved: Split an array into two arrays by a predicate.

description: Recursively flatten arr to a single level. Non-array values are preserved. Empty arrays disappear. Does not mutate input.
